inspiration: Head bob driven by smoothed speed: a cosine-based arc sampler and an effect weight that updates from frame time (files/data/scripts/omw/camera/head_bobbing.lua:25, :30, :33). Recreate as a low-amplitude camera bob on the exploration camera, faded out in fights (camera row 11).

Controller glyphs as two texture families: a PlayStation-style set (circle, square, triangle, x, dpad) and a Steam-style set (a, b, x, y, sticks, triggers, menu, view), picked per device, placed as ImageBox widgets (files/data/mygui/openmw_controllerbuttons.layout:16-17). Recreate for touch and gamepad prompts with our own glyph shapes.

Two display fonts for flavour text: a demonic-letter face and a card-style face (files/data/fonts/DemonicLetters.ttf, MysticCards.ttf). Use the title style only, never for body text; our own font or a licence-clean free font needed for anything shipped.
Water ripple from a separate normal-map PNG (files/data/textures/omw/water_nm.png; name only, not opened). Pair a ripple normal map with our Gerstner-style sum for a surface that reads at 375 wide.

Colour and post effects as named files (files/data/shaders/*.omwfx: adjustments, bloomlinear, internal_distortion, debug). Pattern for row 16 (colour grade): one named effect file per grade and per quality level, switched by setting.

UI separated into layout and skin: MyGUI .layout files describe structure; .skin.xml and core.skin hold the look (files/data/mygui/). Keep the same split for our HUD so a dark or high-contrast skin swaps without touching layouts (hud-ui topic).
Gameplay scripts split by concern: camera, input, mechanics, ui folders (files/data/scripts/omw/). Pattern for our client modules: one file per concern, so the camera and HUD never own game rules.

briefs.label: Rippling marsh water
briefs.why: A normal map on a flat water plane gives fine ripples at low cost, so the surface reads close up and from far off.
briefs.keep: a separate normal-map texture for ripples; a flat plane with a moving normal; a glint from the sun
briefs.change: our own normal map drawn for our world, not the donor's; add a depth-based shoreline tint; a slower swell in combat zones

briefs.label: Gentle walking sway
briefs.why: A cosine ease on the bob makes steps feel soft; the update takes a smoothed speed input (head_bobbing.lua:33), so the bob does not follow raw speed.
briefs.keep: cosine-based arc for the bob; a smoothed speed input; a weight variable updated each frame (effectWeight, head_bobbing.lua:25)
briefs.change: our own amplitude and period; zero bob during the fight camera; a per-zone strength value in the data, not in the script

briefs.label: Dark-title font for zone names
briefs.why: A display face with a strange letter shape sets a mood on zone names and item titles without any art.
briefs.keep: one display face for titles only; a card-style face for item names; no body text in either
briefs.change: our own face or a clearly licensed free face; keep licence text with it; never use a reserved font name on a modified copy
